scripts.test:endtoend: npm run allure:save-history && rimraf allure-results && npm run allure:restore-history && npx playwright test --grep @endtoend
scripts.test:fix: npm run allure:save-history && rimraf allure-results && npm run allure:restore-history && npx playwright test --grep @fix
scripts.test:datadriven: npm run allure:save-history && rimraf allure-results && npm run allure:restore-history && npx playwright test --grep @datadriven
scripts.test:sanity: npm run allure:save-history && rimraf allure-results && npm run allure:restore-history && npx playwright test --grep @sanity
scripts.test:master: npm run allure:save-history && rimraf allure-results && npm run allure:restore-history && npx playwright test --grep @master
scripts.allure:save-history: rimraf allure-history-backup && (xcopy allure-report\history allure-history-backup /E /I /Y || echo no history to backup)
scripts.allure:restore-history: mkdir allure-results && (xcopy allure-history-backup allure-results\history /E /I /Y || echo no history to restore)
scripts.report:allure: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npm run allure:save-history && npx allure open allure-report
